purpose: Keep the agent chat limited to activation and terminal status while all domain detail, evidence, errors and questions are persisted as typed Git responses to MASTER.

patterns.STARTED: GO bestätigt | Agent: {displayName} ({agentId}) | Job: {jobKey} | Status: RUNNING | Zielbranch: {targetBranch}
patterns.BLOCKED: Job {jobKey} blockiert | Status: BLOCKED | Meldung: {detailsRef} | MASTER-Klärung erforderlich
patterns.REIDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED: Agentenidentität unsicher | Status: REIDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED | Bitte im MASTER-Chat neue Initialisierung anfordern

terminalRule: After SUBMITTED, BLOCKED or REIDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED no additional chat content is allowed in the same turn.
